title: Globalisation

blocks.heading: Globalisation
blocks.text: Globalisation is increasing international connectedness and interdependence through flows such as trade, investment, information and people. It differs from global warming, a rise in global average temperature. Communication can support globalisation but does not by itself establish fair access.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: Explain why globalisation is different from global warming. Globalisation concerns international connections and exchange; warming concerns global average temperature. Test the process being described rather than treating the shared word global as a common definition.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Connect the ideas
blocks.text: Connect to Industrialisation (4.1), Production (3.1) and investment/aid (9.2). Keep transaction type, time period, units and local development criteria explicit. The data is fictional.
